_about: LGIC_ENFORCE round 12 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). Round 11 proved the two NEW probes catch the wrong fix by MUTATING THE REAL SUITE. Round 12 asks the question that answer exposed: the other 33 tests hold a PRIVATE BY-PATH COPY of the library, so a substitution of the module the estate actually imports never reaches them, and their greens are no evidence about the shipped predicate. Every figure carries a `claim`, and the moving ones are re-measured by the cell at its own write time.

the_correction_this_round_carries.claim: held -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO ADDENDUM 4 @84b02d1573, correcting BOTH seats' record
the_correction_this_round_carries.statement: S90 falsifies the contrast the CTO's ADDENDUM 3 drew and that THIS SEAT repeated in its L8 packet (msg 98106), in decomposition s.0k.6 and in drive log 20260919T0242Z~G: that round 11's worker 'ENUMERATED rather than fabricated'. Measured: TEST_PROMOTION_R11.json's proofs_re_run names exactly ONE path -- THE CELL'S OWN proof instance -- which cannot have been pinned before an input that did not yet exist. A real path, NEVER AT RISK, which is precisely what `len(listed) > 0` forces when the honest answer is zero.
the_correction_this_round_carries.consequence: BOTH ROUNDS PRODUCED VACUOUS GREENS. The bar had no honest-pass path at a mint at all, so every green it ever produced was vacuous -- it never held. Round 11 is NOT re-opened (the arm is guard-shaped and the four measuring arms were re-exercised by mutation); what changes is what that green MEANS, and no later round may cite it as precedent that the arm works.
the_correction_this_round_carries.this_seat_s_share: The sentence was mine to check and I did not. I read 'one path listed' as enumeration without asking whether the listed path COULD have been at risk -- one field read, in the record I was praising.

stale_proof_bar.statement: When a FIXED INPUT changes mid-round, the record enumerates exactly the proofs that COULD be stale -- this round's own proof instances existing at the parent of the EARLIEST counted commit -- and the arm requires SET EQUALITY, refusing an under-enumeration and an over-enumeration alike. stale_proof_bar.residual_1: AN EXCEPTION IS NOT AN EMPTY SET: a failed retrieval RAISES and the arm FAILS naming the command, because EMPTY is the value that PASSES at a mint and an instrument failure must not be able to buy a green.
stale_proof_bar.residual_2: ONE ordered `git log` over ALL watched paths, so the earliest counted commit is genuinely the earliest; a per-path concatenation gave the oldest of the LAST path only.
